messages.author: 15ae36f84e82f11c
messages.subject: Reference genome of the 8 founder mice.
parts:
Hi,
I am trying to convert the 3D probability array (coded by the eight funders, A to H) to SNP probability (SS/SB/BB) using the function genoprob_to_snpprob().
Where can I find the genotype data of the 8 founders? i.e. Is there a reference genome file that can be easily plug in the 'snpinfo' argument of genoprob_to_snpprob()?
Thanks!!
Dan

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Reference genome of the 8 founder mice.
parts:
The R/qtl2 User Guide, in the section on SNP association, points to the resource we've made available, with genotypes for the Collaborative Cross founders:

    https://kbroman.org/qtl2/assets/vignettes/user_guide.html#connecting_to_snp_and_gene_databases

Namely, there's a SQLite database on Figshare:

    https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.5280229.v3

The user guide no longer talks about how to use genoprob_to_snprob(), as we're expecting that most people would just want to call scan1snps() and not bother with the detailed steps. But basically you need to:

  - use create_variant_query_func() to connect to the snp database
  - call the created function to grab SNP genotypes for some desired region, which could be a whole chromosome
  - call genoprob_to_snpprob() with your genotype or allele probabilities plus the SNP table

karl

parts:
Hi Karl,
Thank you for your answers! Need to bug you again!

To make sure we are on the same page, please find what I did below.
#build query function
query_variants <- create_variant_query_func(paste0(main_path,"/cc_variants.sqlite"))
#query all variants
snpinfo<-query_variants(1, 0, 10000000) #chr1
#get additional info (map to the map file?)
snpinfo<-index_snps(map,snpinfo)  #The map is the one in the islet Rdata (downloaded from https://churchilllab.jax.org/qtlviewers/).
#convert to alleleprob
allele_array<-genoprob_to_snpprob(genoprobs, snpinfo) #The genoprobs is the one in the islet Rdata.

What I got here (allele_array$`1`) is an (500, 2, 49981) array, which means there are 49981 variants. However, I only found 4711 markers in the map file and only 4711 variants available in the genoprobs$`1`.
Could you please help me find out why I got more variants after converting it to allele prob? 
I also noticed that only 64 variants are 'on_map' according to the column of snpinfo. Is that mean only 64 variants in the snpinfo are mappable to the map file? Maybe I misunderstood it. While in the example of the genoprob_to_snpprob function (https://rdrr.io/github/rqtl/qtl2/man/genoprob_to_snpprob.html), all of the four variants are also 'not mappable'.
Thanks!
Dan

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Reference genome of the 8 founder mice.
parts:
genoprob_to_snpprob() uses the genotype probabilities plus genotypes on the founder strains to effectively impute SNP genotypes in the DO mice.
So while you've got genotype data at 4711 variants, the 8 founders have been genotyped at 49,981 variants, and genoprob_to_snpprob() is calculating SNP genotype probabilities at that larger set of variants.

To save effort, it bins SNPs by the pattern of alleles in the founder strains, and by the interval between genotyped markers. The 49,981 SNPs are apparently mostly sitting in intervals between the 4711 variants, but a few are at the same position as those 4711 variants.

karl

parts:
Hi Karl,
Thank you for your help last time!
I got a new problem when converting genotype probabilities to SNP probabilities using the function 'genoprob_to_snpprob()'. The error message is ' interval values outside of the range'. The script and the error are included below. The script worked all right for another dataset (Islet Secretion). I checked that the data format is the same (although the number of markers is much larger in islet than in hippocampus) and the founder mice are consistent. Not sure why.
Dan

#########################
#SCRIPT
chr=1
library(qtl2)

#load genotype data
load('/data/coxvgi/zhoud2/projects/t2d_mouse/raw/qtlviewer_DO_Hippocampus_258_02102020.RData') #https://churchilllab.jax.org/qtlviewer/DO/hippocampus/rdata

#query func
query_variants <- create_variant_query_func("/data/coxvgi/zhoud2/projects/t2d_mouse/raw/cc_variants.sqlite")

#query snpinfo (all)
snpinfo<-query_variants(chr, 0, 10000000)

#generate snpinfo
snpinfo<-index_snps(map,snpinfo)
#colnames(snpinfo)[1]<-'snp'
snpinfo$snp<-paste0('chr',snpinfo$chr,':',snpinfo$pos*1000000)

allele_array<-genoprob_to_snpprob(genoprobs, snpinfo)

#########################  
#ERROR MESSAGE
Error in genoprob_to_snpprob(genoprobs, snpinfo) :
  interval values outside of the range [0, 544].

#########################

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Reference genome of the 8 founder mice.
parts:
My guess is that the map object doesn't correspond to the genoprobs object. The function index_snps() is using the map object to figure out which marker interval each SNP sits in, but then it's saying that index_snps() has given marker intervals that are outside the range of the number of possible intervals in genoprobs.

These two vectors of numbers should be identical:

  sapply(map, length)
  sapply(genoprobs, function(a) dim(a)[3])

karl
